title: W9 counters accumulate over the whole run, not the surge window — the ×0.95 pin is effectively ×0.88 in-window
evidence: core/demand_test.odin:416 `WINDOW := SURGE_END - SURGE_START`; :426 `for tick in u64(1)..=SURGE_END {`; :437-440 `for p in s.flow.packets {` / `if p.class == 1 && p.spawn_tick == tick {` / `stream_spawned += 1` / `per_host_spawns[p.src] += 1`; :463-467 `ceil_cap := (accrue + 999) / 1000` / `bound := ceil_cap + accrue * WINDOW / 1000` / `if per_host_spawns[s.topology.node_id[ns]] > bound { credit_ok = false }`; :470 `testing.expectf(t, stream_spawned >= MIN_LAND,` :471 `"W9 FAIL: the surge must LAND — streaming window spawns %d < %d (expected × 0.95); the capped map cannot source the surge", stream_spawned, MIN_LAND)`
detail: stream_spawned/per_host_spawns count ticks 1..3000 unconditionally, but MIN_LAND and the per-host bound are window-scoped (1800 ticks). Up to ~1199 pre-window base spawns count toward the 17100 bar; the assertion message says "window spawns" while the counter is run-total.
recommended_fix: Gate the increments on `tick >= SURGE_START` (or count `p.spawn_tick >= SURGE_START`), so both the MIN_LAND bar and the per-host bound measure the [1200,3000) window as the card pins.
